---
title: "Data Quality Report"
date: '`r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")`'
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    toc_float: true
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
params:
  output:         { label: "Output Name",              value: output,       input: text }
  output_path:    { label: "Output Path",              value: output_path,  input: text }
  driver:         { label: "Driver",                   value: PostgreSQL,   input: select, choices: [PostgreSQL, ODBC, SQLite] }
  host:           { label: "Host",                     value: default_host, input: text }
  port:           { label: "Port",                     value: 5432,         input: numeric }
  dbname:         { label: "Database Name",            value: database,     input: text }
  schema:         { label: "Schema",                   value: decovid_omop, input: text }
  user:           { label: "User name",                value: user_name,    input: text }
  password:       { label: "Password",                 value: password,     input: password }
  local_hospital: { label: "Hospital name",            value: CCAA,         input: text }
  start_date:     { label: "Start date",               value: start_date,   input: date }
  end_date:       { label: "End date",                 value: end_date,     input: date }
  measurement_tolerance: { label: "Measurement tolerance (%)", value: 5,    input: numeric }
---

h1.title { font-size: 38px; text-align: center; }
h4.date  { font-size: 18px; text-align: center; }
</style>

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(DBI)
library(dbplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(glue)
library(patchwork)

opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, error = FALSE, message = FALSE,
               out.width = "100%", dpi = 300)

ccaa <- params$local_hospital == "CCAA"
```

<br>
<font size="4">Reporting Period: `r params$start_date` to `r params$end_date`</font>
<br><br>

```{r load-data}
ctn        <- setup_ctn(params)
period_ids <- get_period_patients(ctn, params$schema, params$start_date, params$end_date)

obs_period   <- tbl(ctn, in_schema(params$schema, "observation_period")) %>%
  filter(person_id %in% period_ids) %>% collect()
visit_detail <- tbl(ctn, in_schema(params$schema, "visit_detail")) %>%
  filter(person_id %in% period_ids) %>% collect()
measurements <- tbl(ctn, in_schema(params$schema, "measurement")) %>%
  filter(person_id %in% period_ids) %>% collect()
observations_tbl <- tbl(ctn, in_schema(params$schema, "observation")) %>%
  filter(person_id %in% period_ids) %>% collect()
conditions   <- tbl(ctn, in_schema(params$schema, "condition_occurrence")) %>%
  filter(person_id %in% period_ids) %>% collect()
procedures   <- tbl(ctn, in_schema(params$schema, "procedure_occurrence")) %>%
  filter(person_id %in% period_ids) %>% collect()

st         <- prepare_tables(ctn, params$schema) %>% map(~ filter(., person_id %in% period_ids))
overview   <- prepare_overview(st)
care_sites <- unique(st[["person"]]$care_site_id)
vo         <- st[["visit_occurrence"]]

measure_bounds <- read_csv(system.file("data", "measure_bounds.csv", package = "ccaa.inspectEHR"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)
glossary       <- read_csv(system.file("data", "glossary.csv", package = "ccaa.inspectEHR"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE)

DQ <- empty_dq_df()
```

```{r, eval=ccaa}
asis_output(glue("## OMOP Structure at {params$local_hospital}\n"))
knitr::include_graphics('./OMOP structure.jpg')
```

## Glossary

```{r glossary}
glossary %>%
  print_large_kable() %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "25%") %>%
  column_spec(2:ncol(glossary), width = "75%")
```

---

## Person Table

```{r dq-person}
n_person <- nrow(st[["person"]])
n_overv  <- nrow(overview)

DQ <- bind_rows(DQ,

  # Age plausibility
  overview %>%
    summarise(fail_n = sum(age < 0 | age > 120, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(fail_n) %>%
    dq_row("Atemporal plausibility", "Person",
           "Age is between 0 and 120 years", n_overv, fail_n = .),

  # Duplicate person_source_value
  find_duplicates(st[["person"]], "person_source_value") %>%
    dq_row("Uniqueness", "Person",
           "person_source_value is not duplicated", n_person, fail_n = nrow(.)),

  # Completeness: every person appears in linked tables
  check_id_availability(st[["person"]], "person_id", vo,           "person_id") %>%
    dq_row("Completeness", "Person", "Every person has a visit_occurrence",   n_person, fail_n = nrow(.)),
  check_id_availability(st[["person"]], "person_id", obs_period,   "person_id") %>%
    dq_row("Completeness", "Person", "Every person has an observation_period", n_person, fail_n = nrow(.)),
  check_id_availability(st[["person"]], "person_id", visit_detail, "person_id") %>%
    dq_row("Completeness", "Person", "Every person has a visit_detail",        n_person, fail_n = nrow(.)),

  # Year of birth temporal checks
  check_date_within(st[["person"]], "year_of_birth",
                    obs_period, "observation_period_start_date", ">=") %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Person",
           "Year of birth \u2264 observation period start date", n_person, fail_n = nrow(.)),
  check_date_within(st[["person"]], "year_of_birth",
                    compare_date = Sys.Date(), check_arg = ">=") %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Person",
           "Year of birth \u2264 today", n_person, fail_n = nrow(.))
)
```

## Observation Period Table

```{r dq-obs-period}
n_op <- nrow(obs_period)

DQ <- bind_rows(DQ,

  find_duplicates(obs_period,
    c("observation_period_id", "person_id",
      "observation_period_start_date", "observation_period_end_date")) %>%
    nrow() %>%
    dq_row("Uniqueness", "Observation Period",
           "observation_period_id is unique (person, start, end)", n_op, fail_n = .),

  check_date_within(obs_period, "observation_period_start_date",
                    compare_date = Sys.Date(), check_arg = ">") %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Observation Period",
           "Observation period start date is not in the future", n_op, fail_n = nrow(.)),

  check_date_within(obs_period, "observation_period_start_date",
                    obs_period, "observation_period_end_date", ">") %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Observation Period",
           "Observation period end date is after start date", n_op, fail_n = nrow(.))
)
```

## Visit Occurrence Table

```{r dq-visit-occ}
n_vo <- nrow(vo)
vo_dt <- vo %>%
  mutate(start_from_dt = as.Date(visit_start_datetime),
         end_from_dt   = as.Date(visit_end_datetime))

DQ <- bind_rows(DQ,

  overview %>%
    summarise(fail_n = sum(is.na(visit_occurrence_id))) %>%
    pull(fail_n) %>%
    dq_row("Completeness", "Visit Occurrence",
           "All visit_occurrence_ids are populated", n_overv, fail_n = .),

  find_duplicates(vo, c("visit_occurrence_id", "person_id",
                         "visit_start_date", "visit_end_date")) %>%
    nrow() %>%
    dq_row("Uniqueness", "Visit Occurrence",
           "visit_occurrence_id is unique (person, start, end)", n_vo, fail_n = .),

  vo %>%
    filter(!is.na(visit_start_date), !is.na(visit_end_date),
           visit_start_date > visit_end_date) %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Occurrence",
           "Visit start date \u2264 visit end date", n_vo, fail_n = nrow(.)),

  check_date_within(vo_dt, "visit_start_date", vo_dt, "start_from_dt", "!=") %>%
    nrow() %>%
    dq_row("Computational conformance", "Visit Occurrence",
           "visit_start_date matches date(visit_start_datetime)", n_vo, fail_n = .),

  check_date_within(vo_dt, "visit_end_date", vo_dt, "end_from_dt", "!=") %>%
    nrow() %>%
    dq_row("Computational conformance", "Visit Occurrence",
           "visit_end_date matches date(visit_end_datetime)", n_vo, fail_n = .),

  check_date_within(vo, "visit_start_date",
                    obs_period, "observation_period_start_date", "<") %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Occurrence",
           "Visit start date \u2265 observation period start date", n_vo, fail_n = nrow(.)),

  check_date_within(vo, "visit_end_date",
                    obs_period, "observation_period_end_date", ">") %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Occurrence",
           "Visit end date \u2264 observation period end date", n_vo, fail_n = nrow(.)),

  check_date_within(vo, "visit_start_date",
                    compare_date = Sys.Date(), check_arg = ">") %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Occurrence",
           "Visit start date \u2264 today", n_vo, fail_n = nrow(.)),

  check_date_within(vo, "visit_end_date",
                    compare_date = Sys.Date(), check_arg = ">") %>%
    dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Occurrence",
           "Visit end date \u2264 today", n_vo, fail_n = nrow(.))
)
```

## Visit Detail Table

```{r dq-visit-detail}
if (nrow(visit_detail) == 0) {
  cat("The Visit Detail table is empty — skipping checks.\n")
} else {
  n_vd <- nrow(visit_detail)
  vd   <- visit_detail %>%
    mutate(start_from_dt = as.Date(visit_detail_start_datetime),
           end_from_dt   = as.Date(visit_detail_end_datetime))

  DQ <- bind_rows(DQ,

    find_duplicates(vd, c("visit_detail_id", "person_id",
                           "visit_detail_start_date", "visit_detail_end_date")) %>%
      nrow() %>%
      dq_row("Uniqueness", "Visit Detail",
             "visit_detail_id is unique (person, start, end)", n_vd, fail_n = .),

    check_date_within(vd, "visit_detail_start_date", vd, "start_from_dt", "!=") %>%
      nrow() %>%
      dq_row("Computational conformance", "Visit Detail",
             "visit_detail_start_date matches date(visit_detail_start_datetime)",
             n_vd, fail_n = .),

    check_date_within(vd, "visit_detail_end_date", vd, "end_from_dt", "!=") %>%
      nrow() %>%
      dq_row("Computational conformance", "Visit Detail",
             "visit_detail_end_date matches date(visit_detail_end_datetime)",
             n_vd, fail_n = .),

    check_date_within(vd, "visit_detail_start_datetime",
                      obs_period, "observation_period_start_date", "<") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Detail",
             "visit_detail_start_datetime \u2265 observation period start", n_vd, fail_n = nrow(.)),

    check_date_within(vd, "visit_detail_start_date",
                      vo, "visit_start_date", "<") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Detail",
             "visit_detail_start_date \u2265 visit_occurrence start", n_vd, fail_n = nrow(.)),

    check_date_within(vd, "visit_detail_end_date",
                      obs_period, "observation_period_end_date", ">") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Detail",
             "visit_detail_end_date \u2264 observation period end", n_vd, fail_n = nrow(.)),

    check_date_within(vd, "visit_detail_end_date", vo, "visit_end_date", ">") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Detail",
             "visit_detail_end_date \u2264 visit_occurrence end", n_vd, fail_n = nrow(.)),

    check_date_within(vd, "visit_detail_end_date",
                      compare_date = Sys.Date(), check_arg = ">") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Visit Detail",
             "visit_detail_end_date \u2264 today", n_vd, fail_n = nrow(.))
  )
}
```

## Clinical Completeness per Visit-Day

For each visit occurrence, every calendar day between admission and discharge
should have at least one **condition**, one **measurement or observation**, and
one **procedure** recorded.

```{r dq-visit-day-completeness}
# Build the set of all expected visit-days
visit_days <- vo %>%
  filter(!is.na(visit_start_date), !is.na(visit_end_date)) %>%
  select(visit_occurrence_id, person_id, visit_start_date, visit_end_date) %>%
  mutate(day = map2(visit_start_date, visit_end_date, seq, by = "day")) %>%
  unnest(day) %>%
  select(visit_occurrence_id, person_id, day)

n_vdays <- nrow(visit_days)

# Days covered by each clinical domain — one row per visit-day where ≥1 exists
days_with_condition <- conditions %>%
  transmute(visit_occurrence_id, day = as.Date(condition_start_date)) %>%
  distinct()

days_with_meas_obs <- bind_rows(
  measurements    %>% transmute(visit_occurrence_id, day = as.Date(measurement_date)),
  observations_tbl %>% transmute(visit_occurrence_id, day = as.Date(observation_date))
) %>% distinct()

days_with_procedure <- procedures %>%
  transmute(visit_occurrence_id, day = as.Date(procedure_date)) %>%
  distinct()

# Anti-join to find visit-days *missing* each domain
missing_condition  <- visit_days %>%
  anti_join(days_with_condition,  by = c("visit_occurrence_id", "day")) %>% nrow()
missing_meas_obs   <- visit_days %>%
  anti_join(days_with_meas_obs,   by = c("visit_occurrence_id", "day")) %>% nrow()
missing_procedure  <- visit_days %>%
  anti_join(days_with_procedure,  by = c("visit_occurrence_id", "day")) %>% nrow()

DQ <- bind_rows(DQ,
  dq_row("Completeness", "Visit Day",
         "Every visit-day has \u22651 condition recorded",
         n_vdays, missing_condition),
  dq_row("Completeness", "Visit Day",
         "Every visit-day has \u22651 measurement or observation recorded",
         n_vdays, missing_meas_obs),
  dq_row("Completeness", "Visit Day",
         "Every visit-day has \u22651 procedure recorded",
         n_vdays, missing_procedure)
)
```

## Condition Occurrence Table

```{r dq-conditions}
n_co <- nrow(conditions)

if (n_co == 0) {
  cat("The Condition Occurrence table is empty — skipping checks.\n")
} else {
  # Every visit has a condition recorded within 24 h of admission
  visits_with_admit_condition <- conditions %>%
    filter(!is.na(condition_start_date)) %>%
    inner_join(vo %>% select(visit_occurrence_id, visit_start_date),
               by = "visit_occurrence_id") %>%
    filter(as.integer(as.Date(condition_start_date) - visit_start_date) <= 1L) %>%
    distinct(visit_occurrence_id)

  DQ <- bind_rows(DQ,
    nrow(vo) - nrow(visits_with_admit_condition) %>%
      dq_row("Completeness", "Condition Occurrence",
             "Every visit has a condition recorded within 24 h of admission",
             nrow(vo), fail_n = .)
  )
}
```

---

## Measurement Table

Checks performed with `r params$measurement_tolerance`% tolerance.

```{r dq-measurements}
n_m <- nrow(measurements)

DQ <- bind_rows(DQ,

  # Every numeric measurement has a unit
  measurements %>%
    filter(!is.na(value_as_number),
           is.na(unit_concept_id) | unit_concept_id == 0) %>%
    dq_row("Completeness", "Measurement",
           "Every value_as_number has a unit_concept_id", n_m, fail_n = nrow(.)),

  # Value plausibility — single join, no loops
  dq_measurement_plausibility(measurements, measure_bounds, params$measurement_tolerance)
)
```

## Death Table

```{r dq-death}
death <- st[["death"]]
n_d   <- nrow(death)

if (n_d == 0) {
  cat("The Death table is empty — skipping checks.\n")
} else {
  death_yr <- death %>%
    mutate(death_year = as.integer(format(as.Date(death_date, "%d/%m/%Y"), "%Y")))

  DQ <- bind_rows(DQ,

    check_date_within(death_yr, "death_year",
                      st[["person"]], "year_of_birth", "<") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Death",
             "Year of death \u2265 year of birth", n_d, fail_n = nrow(.)),

    check_date_within(death, "death_date",
                      obs_period, "observation_period_start_date", "<") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Death",
             "Death date \u2265 observation period start", n_d, fail_n = nrow(.)),

    check_date_within(death, "death_date",
                      obs_period, "observation_period_end_date", "!=") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Death",
             "Death date = observation period end date", n_d, fail_n = nrow(.)),

    check_date_within(death, "death_date",
                      vo, "visit_start_date", "<") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Death",
             "Death date \u2265 visit start date", n_d, fail_n = nrow(.)),

    check_date_within(death, "death_date",
                      compare_date = Sys.Date(), check_arg = ">") %>%
      dq_row("Temporal plausibility", "Death",
             "Death date \u2264 today", n_d, fail_n = nrow(.))
  )
}
```

## Data Quality Results

```{r dq-summary-plot, fig.height=3.5}
plot_dq_summary(DQ)
```

```{r dq-heatmap, fig.height=max(7, nrow(DQ) * 0.38)}
plot_dq_heatmap(DQ)
```

```{r dq-table}
DQ %>%
  mutate(`Failing n (%)` = glue("{Fail_n} ({Fail_pct}%)")) %>%
  select(Domain, Category, Check, N, Status, `Failing n (%)`) %>%
  print_large_kable(max_rows = 200) %>%
  column_spec(5, color = if_else(DQ$Status == "Pass", "#379481", "#c0392b"), bold = TRUE)
```
